title: Inspector — what they may and may not do in Sales

steps.do: Open Left menu → Sales and each tile in turn: Leads, Opportunities, Inquiries, Quotes, Quote templates, Pre-order checklist, Project costing, Approvals, Pipelines & funnels, Set up Sales.
steps.expect: Opens exactly what the matrix allows; anything else is refused with a sentence (never a blank page or an error).
steps.observed: No Sales item in the inspector's menu (field screen); every tile address typed. Leads: refused ("Sales & CRM — restricted You don’t have permission to open Leads & pip") [no tile — address typed]; Opportunities: refused ("Sales & CRM — restricted You don’t have permission to open Leads & pip") [no tile — address typed]; Inquiries: refused ("Sales & CRM — restricted You don’t have permission to open CRM — Inqui") [no tile — address typed]; Quotes: refused ("Sales & CRM — restricted You don’t have permission to open CRM — Quota") [no tile — address typed]; Quote templates: refused ("You cannot m
steps.note: The "Approvals" address opens the inspector's own approvals inbox ("Everything waiting on your decision") — empty, no Sales data; it is not a Sales screen for them.

steps.do: Try what the permission matrix says they may do: Own jobs only.
steps.observed: My jobs opens ("My Jobs") — the inspector's own jobs screen; no job was allocated in this copy, so only that it opens (and holds no Sales data) was checked.

steps.do: Try what the matrix says they may NOT do: Any Sales screen.
steps.expect: Each is refused (button absent, or a refusal sentence when the address is typed).
steps.observed: /sales: open ("Sales"); /crm-dashboard: refused ("Sales & CRM — restricted You don’t have permission"); /quotes: refused ("Sales & CRM — restricted You don’t have permission"); /leads: refused ("Sales & CRM — restricted You don’t have permission")

steps.do: Type the address of a refused screen directly.
steps.expect: Refused the same way — hiding the button is not enough.
steps.observed: /quote-new → "Sales & CRM — restricted You don’t have permission"; /lead-new → "Sales & CRM — restricted You don’t have permission"; /inquiry-new → "Sales & CRM — restricted You don’t have permission"; /project-costings → "You do not have access to project costing."; /pipelines → "Sales & CRM — restricted You don’t have permission"; /sales-setup → "Sales & CRM — restricted You don’t have permission"
